title: Claude Code: /design and Cowork
content:
## Overview

Two things changed in Claude Code's surface area during August 2026: the **`/design` command** landed as a research preview, and **Cowork** expanded beyond desktop to web and mobile. Both point the same direction — Claude Code moving from a terminal-only tool toward something that spans design, implementation, and multiple devices.

---

## The `/design` Command

Released **2026-08-17** as a research preview, `/design` brings Claude Design's **artboard workflow** into the Claude Code CLI and Desktop app. It is built on Artifacts.

### How it works

```
/design a few options for the settings panel
```

Claude reads your codebase to match its existing UI style, then produces several editable artboards laid out on a single pan/zoom canvas, published as an Artifact. You pick one, tweak it directly (click-to-select elements, a properties panel, inline text editing, undo/redo), and then have Claude implement the version you settled on.

### Why it matters

The previous workflow meant leaving the terminal for `claude.ai/design`, producing a mock there, and pasting code back. `/design` closes that loop — the design step happens where the code already is, and the resulting artboard is a shareable Artifact rather than a screenshot.

### Availability

- Plans: Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise
- CLI: version **2.1.183** or later
- Desktop: **1.13576.0** or later

Artifacts support is the gating requirement, since artboards are published as Artifacts.

---

## Cowork on Web and Mobile

As of August 2026, **Cowork runs on web and mobile** in addition to the desktop app. Sessions can run **remotely in beta**, with files and session state saved to your Claude account and synced across devices.

The practical effect: a session started on a laptop can be picked up on a phone, because the working state lives in the account rather than only in the local process.

---

## Other August 2026 Claude Code Changes

Selected releases from the month:

| Version | Date | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 2.1.232 | Aug 13 | `@` mentions to collaborate across multiple sessions |
| 2.1.233 | Aug 14 | GitLab merge requests in the worktree view; memory limits on runaway build commands |
| 2.1.234 | Aug 17 | Auto-continue sessions when usage limits reset; stronger protections against credential leakage |
| 2.1.239 | Aug 21 | `/claude-api upgrade` migrates Python projects from `anthropic` 0.x to 1.x; better plugin syncing in cloud sessions |
| 2.1.241 | Aug 23 | Bug-fix and reliability release, no new features |

A **Concise output style** also shipped, making Claude lead with the result and skip preamble.

---

## Developer Platform Alongside

The Claude Developer Platform added governance controls for **Claude Managed Agents** in the same window: session budgets, advisor models, inference geo pinning (for data residency), and **GitHub-hosted skills**.

---

## Reading the Trend

The month's changes cluster into three themes:

1. **Design moves into the coding loop** — `/design` treats UI mockups as a step before implementation rather than a separate tool.
2. **Sessions become portable** — Cowork sync, cross-session `@` mentions, and auto-continue all reduce the cost of a session being interrupted.
3. **Guardrails for teams** — memory limits, credential-leak protections, session budgets, and geo pinning are all operational controls rather than capability additions.
